title: Ciabatta workspace config
description: A sub-workspace's .ciabatta/ciabatta.yaml: who it is in the monorepo, what it depends on, and how to reach the registries and caches it uses.

ci.description: Which CI system to read build metadata from. Auto-detected when unset.

containers.description: Container runtime. When unset, ciabatta auto-detects whichever is installed.

workspace.description: This directory's identity as a sub-workspace of the monorepo — written by `ciabatta init --lib`, absent for a standalone project.

name.description: This sub-workspace's name across the monorepo. Defaults to the directory name.

description.description: One line on what lives here. `ciabatta list` prints it.

owner.description: Who owns this sub-workspace — a name, handle, or team. Unset shows as "unowned".

depends_on.description: Other sub-workspaces every workflow here depends on: "<member>" for their same-named workflow, or "<member>:<workflow>" for one specific workflow.

tags.description: Free-form labels for search (`ciabatta list --search backend`).

requires.description: Tools every workflow here needs on PATH.

stale_after.description: How long a workflow may go unrun before ciabatta reports it stale ("30d", "6h"). Read from the monorepo root and applied to every member, since how long is too long is a property of how the team works rather than of any one package. Every run records what it ran; with a remote cache configured those records are shared, so "nobody has run this since March" is answerable rather than just "I haven't".

env_file.description: .env file path(s) relative to this sub-workspace, sourced before any of its workflows run. Unset means `.env`; setting it REPLACES that default rather than adding to it.

env_default.description: The checked-in template the .env is generated from when it's missing — conventionally `.env.default`. Required of any workspace whose workflows declare REQUIRED_ENV.

env.description: Environment variables applied to every step defined here.

umbrella.description: Set on the monorepo root when the root is only an umbrella — shared `toolchain:` and `env:` — rather than a package of its own.

workflows.description: Workflows written inline, for a sub-workspace small enough not to want a file each. The usual home is .ciabatta/workflows/<name>.yaml.

toolchain.description: How to install the build tools workflows declare in `requires`. Usually written once at the monorepo root and inherited by every sub-workspace, so "install X" is written down where the person hitting the error will see it.

hint.description: The command that installs it, printed verbatim when it's missing.

check.description: An alternative way to detect the tool when a bare PATH lookup won't do. Run through the shell; a zero exit means present.

description.description: What the tool is for, in one line.

registries.description: The registries `push` and `pull` steps transfer through, by name.

url.description: Base URL of the registry. For Nexus with `repository` set, this is the bare host — the /repository/<repository> segment is appended automatically.

type.description: Explicit registry type. Inferred from the registry's name when absent.

login_script.description: A command that authenticates against this registry before a transfer.

repository.description: Nexus only: the repository to publish into.

base_path.description: Nexus raw only: a path prefix prepended to every publish_path, so raw artifacts land under a common folder.

format.description: Nexus only: the repository format, selecting how the push happens — HTTP PUT, `npm publish`, or `twine upload`.

cache.description: Build caching for this workspace. Per-workflow `cache:` blocks narrow it; the `remote:` server belongs here, since that is one endpoint per checkout rather than a property of any one build.

analyze.description: Optional inputs for `ciabatta analyze` (paths relative to the project root).

requirements.description: A file listing project requirements, one per line (`id` or `id, description`).

trace.description: A CSV tracing requirements to source files (columns: requirement, file).

ai.description: Settings for the `ciabatta ai` assistant (see `ciabatta ai setup`).

provider.description: Which wire format to speak. `openai` and `vllm` both cover any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio).

endpoint.description: Base URL of the API. Defaults per provider; point it at a local or remote server for self-hosted models.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key.

tls_verify.description: Verify the endpoint's TLS certificate. Turn it off only for a self-hosted endpoint behind a self-signed cert.

images.description: Container base images the assistant may spin up as sandboxes. It can only use images listed here.

verify.description: Command that proves the project still builds after the assistant changes code (`cargo test`, `npm run build`). The agent loop won't finish a code-changing task until this passes. Omitted, it is auto-detected; set it to an empty string to turn the gate off.

max_tokens.description: Ceiling on the model's reply length per request. Claude requires a value (default 8192); OpenAI-compatible endpoints only receive it when set. Raise it if large edits are being truncated mid-tool-call.

max_tool_rounds.description: Cap on model/tool round trips per question (default 50). Raise it for long autonomous tasks; lower it to fail fast on a confused model.
